bb.name: Activity Sidebar
bb.description: Experimental: it may break with a bb update. Replaces bb's thread list with one Activity list of every parent thread from every project, latest first, with pinned threads above it and the Working, Asleep and Archived shelves folded at its foot. While you have regional managers, a row tops it with a small Managers | Threads icon segment and the shown view's options: Managers shows the pinned ones as a grid of avatars above the rest, listed oldest first by their avatar, name and the first sentence of their latest message, and Threads is the list without them. Each view has its own project filter and a Compact switch for one-line rows. Each row shows the thread's agent, its project's coloured initial, its title, its pull request, how many threads run under it, and its state or how long ago it last moved. Right-click a row for bb's own thread menu, with Sleep (or Wake) added; under the pointer, its corner offers Archive. A thread put to sleep waits on Asleep until its time, then comes back to the top. Rest on a row for its card: its state and since when, machine, project, branch, pull request, its plan while it works, and a tree of its subthreads to open.
